title: Soundcore Sleep A30 Special $158.40 (RRP $319) + Delivery ($4.00, $0 C&C) @ The Good Guys Commercial (Membership required)
body:
Deal: Soundcore Sleep A30 Special $158.40 (RRP $319) + Delivery ($4.00, $0 C&C) @ The Good Guys Commercial (Membership required)

[spirrowhack] Earplugs don't play white noise, these ones also play whatever you want through them, not just white noise.
[eug] I don't think you understand what these do.
[shmahoo] Yeah. And are you even a real doctor?
Lol
[Imjustsayin] I have the non-special so slightly weaker battery, took me a while to get used to them but the noise cancelling is sufficient, the adaptive snore and other features i have not used. At this price worth it, if you have noise keeping you awake play some whitenoise via bluetooth (preferred over the built in app offerings) though the battery life might struggle past 7-8 hours.
And they are pretty comfy to sleep in, even used them on a plane to blend out the noise and made sleeping easier than other in ear or over ears.
[Donkey Oaty] I find the adaptive snore feature decent, if there is enough noise in the room they will play gentle rain sounds.
[paloverde88] You can program it to stop when you have fallen asleep I always fall asleep before the music is over
[itsfree] I can't sleep without these. I used to use foam earplugs with a NRR of 33, but these are significantly superior. I don't even use them to play anything most nights - just the perfect fit and ANC alone blocks out the footsteps/furniture dragging from my upstairs neighbour. I went on a cruise with them, and it blocked out heavy snoring from my bunkmate, as well as the ship noises. I also used them as normal earbuds throughout the trip – so comfortable and low profile.
Only issue is the left earbuds sometimes takes a few min to go full volume now - it's a common fault with these based on what I've read .
[Sleptice] I own a pair can hands down recommend it for anyone who cant sleep due to noise.
[Indomie5] Can we use the 20% discount code for TGG Commercial?
[Indomie5] 20% off Storewide with 90 Day StoreCash Sign Up and Activation (Exclusions Apply) @ The Good Guys
[r3b00t] Is it better than good silicone earplugs? what about the fit all night through?
I use these one, very good but keep losing them midnight regarding of the size https://www.chemistwarehouse.com.au/buy/149635/otifleks-good…
[paloverde88] Just wipe the silicone with alcohol every couple of days you should be washing your ears when you shower A30 or not
[Frackingiscool] I am jealous of people who can sleep with these in. I have tried a few earplugs (silicone ones like loop, mutepods, off branded etc), foam plugs, gel plugs, etc. they don't fit/shift or put too much pressure on my messed up ear canals.
It's getting way too expensive to drink enough to sleep through my wife's snoring.
[ozbargainhunter400] Custom fitted are like 30$. Mix the two putties like epoxy or mission impossible gum, and you have like 5 mins to mould it.
[eug] They become firm when cured so if pressure on the ear canal is a problem even with squishy gel plugs, OP would probably find it painful too.
[ozbargainhunter400] I found because theyre custom fit, they fit my tiny canals 1:1. My canals are smaller than an infants canals, I was suffering with adult ear plugs until I found custom fits and infant ear plugs!
[melans] @ozbargainhunter400: Where'd you get them from?
[ozbargainhunter400] @melans: Excuse the name, but earjobs
Google them if you’re interested!
Heaps of place sell it, I wouldn’t pay over $50. The seal is not as sealing as an IEM style (read: etymotics, aka ear rapers) but will reduce a fair amount.
I used them until I found out about infant ear plugs, used for motorcycling. Loud pipes don’t save ear drums!
[carpecrash] Does anyone find these work better at staying in your ears than a paid or Airpods Pro 2s?
[mith] Any chance anyone can post a screenshot of this in a cart? Cheers
[itsfree] Just saw the Soundcore AeroClip Open Earbuds for a great price when searching for these too https://www.ozbargain.com.au/node/968374
[itsfree] I know that. That's not why I shared it.
[bigAlOz] In my opinion, these are the best on the market. For me, the Bose were more comfortable but are no longer available due to the battery issue.
The main thing I like about these is that they can run independently of your phone. ie you don't have to use Bluetooth. When I need them, I just put them into my ear, and they work straight away. Handy if you are asleep and get woken up by noise. You don't need to mess around with your phone.
Great price also.
[delusioned] I have the first version which last for 5 hours - sometimes when the battery is dead, I wake up.
How many hours do these last for?
[123flyer] Does your current sleep buds make a noise when its low on battery or when its out of battery?
[delusioned] I think it's the sudden stop of sounds that wake me up. It doesn't scream LOW BATTERY
[Justplanemad] When you say the first version do you mean the A10s I think they were called? Or early a30 versions.
[pencilman] What about for long flights?
Anyone have experienced of the noise cancelling in that environment?
[yaozy] ordered a pair, says order under review but took the money swiftly out of my acc haha
[Goonos] I found these just a bit too uncomfortable when side sleeping and would wake up with my ear aching. The discontinued Bose version I found more comfortable. Personally I find the basic wax plugs the most comfortable.
[Justplanemad] The Ozlo ones that bought the Bose Sleepbuds design?
[Goonos] The Bose originals v1 and v2. This is going back like 6+ years ago. I just use cheap wax ones now. While passive sound blocking, I find they conform well to the ears which makes them quite effective and unlike foam I dont seem to get ear infections from them.
[itsfree] IIRC I had a bit of that initially, but my ears got used to them
[leftspeaker2000] I have these. They are fantastic. I paid full price and would probably pay it again if they broke.
[wearytraveller] What kind of real world battery life are you getting?
[leftspeaker2000] I think i get 7 hours using the built-in sounds with ANC off. On Bluetooth, it's like 4-5. ANC is not worth it.
[wearytraveller] Oh that does not sound like a good upgrade from the A20s then, cos ANC is one of the bigger selling points. I would expect the battery life to get worse over time as well.
[wigglyturtle] interested in these but what about your alarm, does it play through the speakers?
[leftspeaker2000] You can set it up to stop playing sounds one you fall asleep but that said, the ANC and the seal is not that good. So, a bit of ambient noise gets through.
[nategasm] Yes they have a separate alarm you can set which directly play through the earbuds.
[gasman70] I am thinking of getting a pair for the wife, but she has tiny ears. How small are these?
[leftspeaker2000] small enough that you can sleep on your side.
[leftspeaker2000] Yes, perfect. Originally a tiny bit painful but got used to it after a few days. Now no issue.
[OzSikh] Hey man, do u play any sound or not while sleeping?
[OzSikh] Hey man, do u play any sound or not while sleeping?
[OzSikh] Hey man, do u play any sound or not while sleeping?
[montorola] Lol @ sleeping with earplugs in.
I'm too paranoid about teenagers breaking in these days to do that
[scalebearer] Price is exceptional, these are the Soundcore Sleep A30 Special, not to be confused with the Soundcore Sleep A30 (I think the only difference is the special has better battery life).
On release, they were supposed to have better battery life and a cheaper price . I think the market will probably cancel out the difference and more for the older version in due time, since there's no reason to purchase the A30 non special for more money.
On a different note, make sure to give your ear canals some time to air out and do its other natural processes at least a few hours a day. I.e. If your ears are stuffed with normal earbuds for most of the day and stuffed with sleep earbuds for most of the night, there may be consequences at some point.
[wearytraveller] Has anyone compared their effectiveness with the A20s? I have these and find passive noise cancellation non existent. But battery life is far better than these.
[leftspeaker2000] I have not used the A20s, but they don't seal that great. But its good enough. You can get 7-8 hours of built in sound without ANC on.
[Suibiankankan] wow good price. Bought one for my dad a few weeks ago, he is really happy about it
[JJkx] Can you hear your alarm with this?
I am worried to missed my alarm in early morning
[nategasm] You can set a separate alarm for these which play directly through the earbuds even when the battery runs out.
[Binggggo] I have used good guys commercial before, but not for months, and now when I enter my details it says “please enter your password” even though I have entered a password? Have tried a couple of iPad browsers, and pc laptop browser. Anyone else have the same issue?
[eug] I had the same issue, it keeps asking me to enter my password. In the end I went through my Origin portal which logged me in when I clicked through.
[paloverde88] These are really good headsets have fallen asleep everytime wearing them still had my ears the next morning it masks my French bulldogs loud snoring such a lifesaver I paid much more
